messages.subject: Re: MathJax as input label
parts:
Try an inline equation instead (delimited using \( and \) ):

numericInput("se.x", "\\(SE_\\hat{a}\\):",1)


On Fri, Apr 11, 2014 at 5:25 AM, Taylor Baldwin
<taylora...@gmail.com> wrote:
> I want to use MathJax for some of my input labels, however it doesn't show
> up in the same spot as a normal label. Is there a way to get the MathJax
> equation to show up in the typical spot?
>
> This is what I have for the input in ui.R:
>
> numericInput("se.x",("$$SE_\\hat{a}$$:"),1),
>
> And I have attached an image for how this shows up.
> Thanks for any help!
